newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products fall, gas oil off $2.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products fall, gas oil off $2.

text.p: Most NWE oil products dipped on Friday with the Assumption Day holiday in many European countries keeping trade very thin, traders said.
Gasoline fell, hovering around the $229 mark as September swaps came off $1 to $2 to $202.50 and October to $192.50.
Outright gas oil prices declined by $2 in line with September IPE which was trading at $171.75 a tonne.
Heating oil barge premiums were steady at September IPE -25 cents.
